note: A clan with no opinions. Every drive equally likely until something teaches it otherwise. Useful for tests and for watching a culture form from nothing.
Flees early, keeps close, does not experiment. Survives a dangerous world and discovers nothing in a safe one.
Meets things. Eats well until it meets the wrong thing.
Stays together and looks after its own. Transmits everything fast, including panic.
Gathers past sufficiency and handles objects. The closest thing in the catalog to a starting culture for tool use.
Leaves before it has to. Finds more and holds less.
